title: Mixed sizes and line-heights per line
units: CSS px relative to the container border box; line baseline relative to the line top

f1-number.note: root 10px lh 1.5, span 20px inherits the number

f1-px.note: root lh 12px inherited as px by a 20px span

f1-strut-larger.note: root 20px lh 40px, 10px span: the strut dominates

f1-strut-smaller.note: root 10px lh 10px, 30px span lh 30px: the content dominates

f1-span-lh-smaller.note: 30px span with line-height 5px inside root lh 20px

f1-nested.html: a b c d e

f1-empty-box.note: an empty 30px span lh 30px on a line with text

f1-empty-box-only.note: an empty 30px span alone on the first line

f1-empty-root.note: no inline content: an empty span only

f1-wrap-mixed.note: wrapping text where only the second line carries a 20px span
